text:
sam_marketing: Heads up  Gartner outreach: they want a pre-brief on our new benchmark report next Mon and asked if we can provide an embargoed preview. Need to align on data extracts, approved talking points, and publish timing. @jonathan_pr @legal_kate @research_alex

jonathan_pr: Thanks Sam. Is this an inclusion in their quadrant or a mentions-only blurb? Need scope.

research_alex: They said "marketnote" and may quote our latency/cost numbers. We should be cautious about hard numbers unless we can cite methodology.

sam_marketing: Right now it's a marketnote mention + potential callout box with a line from our benchmark. They asked for a 200-word preview and access to the benchmarks repo (sanitized).

legal_kate: No direct numbers without methodology disclosure. We can provide relative statements like "in our internal benchmark, model X on Redwood Inference showed lower median p95 latency vs baseline" but avoid specific percentages unless Alex confirms test rig and stats.

research_alex: I can produce a sanitized summary and the test harness metadata. Will remove absolute cluster specs and anonymize partner IDs. Will include test commands and seed prompts.

product_maya: If Gartner quotes any performance claims we should ensure they include model version and seq len. Otherwise folks will misinterpret. Also we should decide if this triggers our public benchmark blog or if this is strictly embargoed with them.

analyst_relations: Gartner prefers a 48h embargo on marketnotes. They asked for the preview Friday COB if we want inclusion on Monday release. If we do our own blog, we should coordinate dates; sometimes analyst notes leak earlier.

press_ops: Let's lock press outreach until after the analyst note publishes. We should prepare reactive messaging for top trades the moment the analyst note is live. I can draft a 2-paragraph news nugget and have a list of reporters on standby.

sam_marketing: Proposed timeline: Alex posts sanitized preview here by Thu EOD, legal signs off Fri morning, we approve embargo to Gartner for Fri COB, they publish Mon 10:00 ET, we publish our benchmark blog Mon 10:05 ET, socials 10:10 ET. Thoughts?

jonathan_pr: That timeline works but legal needs time. Suggest Alex earlier (Wed EOD) so legal has Fri morning buffer. Also, we should have an executive quote approved (CEO or Head of Product) for the blog.

legal_kate: Confirmed. If Alex posts Wed EOD I'll review Thu and request edits Fri morning if needed. Note: any comparative claims vs named vendors will require explicit substantiation.

research_alex: I'll push the sanitized preview Wed 18:00 PT. It will include: test harness, model/version, tokenization config, input prompt suite (anonymized). No raw logs.

product_maya: I'll draft an exec quote and circulate Thu morning. Prefer it come from the Head of Product for technical credibility.

analyst_relations: Reminder: Gartner may ask for limited access to the benchmark repo (read-only). Do we want to host a timed access link or provide a zipped artifact?

sam_marketing: Provide a zipped artifact with hashed IDs and an explanatory README. No live repo access. Keep it scoped to the sanitized tests.

press_ops: I'm prepping the reactive email and press one-pager. Once we have the final timing I'll ping priority reporters. Also recommend we prepare a short FAQ anticipating questions about methodology and generalizability.

jonathan_pr: Also: if Gartner includes a chart with our numbers we should get preview rights. Can we request a screenshot approval clause in the embargo?

legal_kate: We can request preview rights but they may decline. We can include a small clause in the embargo agreement asking for pre-publication review of direct quotes and charts referencing our data. It'll be best-effort, not guaranteed.

research_alex: Noted. I'll prepare a chart export (PNG + underlying CSV) for easier review if Gartner asks.

sam_marketing: Action list: (1) Alex 2d sanitized preview Wed EOD. (2) Maya 2d exec quote Thu AM. (3) Legal 2d review Thu-Fri. (4) Press_ops 2d reactive assets ready and reporter list on standby. (5) Analyst_relations 2d negotiate preview clause with Gartner.

analyst_relations: I'll circulate the embargo language and ask for the screenshot preview clause. Will advise if Gartner pushes back.

product_maya: Exec quote posted: "Our benchmark shows Redwood Inference optimizes for predictable latency under realistic chat loads, enabling product teams to ship fast without sacrificing quality." Please review.

legal_kate: Minor tweak: replace "shows" with "indicates" and add caveat: "Results based on internal benchmark methodology; your mileage may vary." Approving with that language.

jonathan_pr: Approved. I'll be ready to hit out to analysts we have relationships with once we see the final marketnote.

research_alex: Sanitized preview uploaded: https://internal.redwood/sandbox/benchmarks/sanitized-gartner-preview.zip (internal link). Contains README, PNGs, CSVs.

legal_kate: Reviewing now. If no issues I'll send signed embargo acceptance by Fri COB.

sam_marketing: Great work. Everyone please flag any blocker ASAP. If Gartner declines preview rights, we default to our original plan: publish blog Mon and treat analyst note as independent mention.

press_ops: Will prepare the outreach thread and have the embargo-ready press release in draft. Standby for final timestamp. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
